A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''daughter''' of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Fieler Dan]]. The daughter ran a group called "[[Undercity Assistance]]" during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Black Sun territory]] and [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]], working with refugees.
